The benchmarks include metrics such as precision, latency, frames per second (FPS), accuracy, and the Deployment Efficiency Score (DES) for different models like MobileNetV3-L, ResNet50, and ConvNeXt-Tiny.

For instance, the Raspberry Pi 5 benchmarks show that MobileNetV3-L with FP32 precision has a latency of 14.88 ms, an FPS of 67.21, and an accuracy of 85.47%. In contrast, the same model with INT8 precision has a latency of 32.58 ms, an FPS of 30.69, and a significantly lower accuracy of 41.69%. The Jetson Nano benchmarks also provide similar metrics, highlighting the performance differences across architectures and quantization strategies.

Overall, the benchmarking results indicate variability in performance based on the hardware platform and the quantization method used, emphasizing the importance of selecting the appropriate configuration for optimal deployment in edge AI applications.
